title: Embedded Protection: A Must-Have Feature in Equipment Rental
summary: Embedded Protection: A Must-Have Feature in Equipment Rental
body_markdown:
It’s vital to be proactive if you lease out equipment no matter the industry. From baby equipment, to heavy machinery for construction, or valuable assets, your survival in this ever-changing industry depends on a future mindset. With the equipment rental market constantly shifting and growing, it's time to talk about a game-changing feature that can make or break your[sustained success: embedded protection](https://www.tint.ai/blog/embedded-protection-builds-customer-confidence-for-marketplaces) .


First, a little about us: we're Tint, the first-of-its-kind protection platform with over 60 years of combined industry experience. Our bread and butter is[Assurance backed by Insurance](https://www.tint.ai/glossary) and embedded protection, and we're here to talk about why it's crucial for your equipment rental platform. We created this guide to empower you to make informed decisions for your business by embracing a concept you may not have previously considered but that can quickly become a catalyst for innovation and growth.


## **The Changing Landscape of Equipment Rental**


So…why embedded protection? The equipment sharing market is in a state of constant flux. Rental companies are no longer just looking for basic solutions to manage their marketplaces; they seek comprehensive platforms that provide company-wide visibility and centralized data management. In this age of information and connectivity, staying ahead of the curve is crucial. But what exactly should you be looking for in an embedded protection solution for your equipment rental platform in 2024? Let's break it down with some stats to back it up.


## Analytics and Business Intelligence (BI)


To enhance the efficiency of your embedded protection program, it's important to leverage the power of data. An embedded protection solution equipped with advanced analytics and business intelligence capabilities can provide you with graphical insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) through dashboards. This feature can help you stay ahead of the curve by providing valuable information to improve your protection program's performance.


- Predict program risk accurately
- Improve financial planning and budgeting with evidence-based data
- Adjust rental rates and pricing based on solid data-backed insights


****


[*source: Forbes](http://www.forbes.com/sites/louiscolumbus/2014/06/24/roundup-of-analytics-big-data-business-intelligence-forecasts-and-market-estimates-2014/)


## Innovation


Adopting technological advancements and implementing[embedded protection programs](https://www.tint.ai/glossary) in your marketplace is crucial to remaining competitive in the equipment rental industry. This fosters innovation and growth and ensures all users a safe and secure rental experience.


- Strategize based on evolving technology trends
- Be dynamic in your business offerings
- Leverage role-based business processes for efficiency


****[*source: PwC](http://www.pwc.com/gx/en/ceo-survey/)


## IoT - Equipment Tracking and Monitoring


By integrating IoT technology, you can keep track of your equipment's availability, location, and utilization in real-time and revolutionize your embedded protection program. This innovative approach will allow you to enhance your asset monitoring and protection with greater efficiency and security.


- Ensure customers adhere to the rental contract
- Plan preventive maintenance based on actual equipment usage
- Enhance customer experience with data analytics on equipment utilization


[*source: Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/976313/global-iot-market-size/)


## Cloud Technology


An[equipment rental marketplace](https://www.tint.ai/glossary) 's embedded protection program can significantly benefit from investing in cloud technology. By leveraging connectivity, automation, and AI, cloud technology can simplify and enhance the protection program. For instance, cloud technology can allow for real-time monitoring of rental equipment, improving the accuracy of damage assessments and helping prevent fraudulent claims. Additionally and most importantly, automation can streamline the claims process, making it faster and more efficient for both the rental marketplace and the renters. Overall, investing in cloud technology can improve the effectiveness of the embedded protection program and provide a better rental experience for customers.


- Scalability with any time, anywhere access
- Robust data protection and governance
- A future-proof solution that is running on the latest technology


[*source: McKinsey](https://www.cloudzero.com/blog/cloud-computing-market-size#:~:text=By%202030%2C-,McKinsey%20predicts,-that%20cloud%20adoption)


## Unified Technology Stack


When it comes to an equipment rental marketplace's embedded protection program, simplicity is key. Utilizing a single tech-stack approach minimizes integration complexities and repetitive processes are automated, ultimately saving time and money. This streamlines the rental process for both renters and providers and ensures that the protection program is efficient and effective. With a simplified and automated approach, the rental marketplace can focus on providing top-notch equipment and customer service. At the same time, the embedded protection program seamlessly works in the background to provide peace of mind for all parties involved.


- Simplify technology investments
- Speed up time to market with rapid automation
- Offer a user-friendly interface for your team


[*source ManageEngine](https://download.manageengine.com/analytics-plus/docs/ebook-on-6-expenditure-unified-it-analytics.pdf)


## End-to-End Business Processing


We all know that dealing with complicated rental procedures can be a nuisance for you and your customers. But, with an integrated solution that simplifies the rental process from start to finish, you can easily keep track of your equipment and ensure its timely return with all required documents. A smooth process also minimizes the risk of loss, which is crucial. The best part is that your customers will love the hassle-free user experience while you benefit from increased efficiency behind the scenes.


- Modernized processes for improved efficiency
- Reduced time, costs, manual effort, and errors
- Enhanced operations and productivity


[*source: McKinsey](https://www.mckinsey.com/~/media/mckinsey/dotcom/client_service/operations/pdfs/lean_and_mean-how_does_your_supply_chain_shape_up.pdf)


## Customer Focus


With complete journey visibility, an equipment rental marketplace's embedded protection program can provide a better customer experience. By tracking the rental equipment from start to finish, customers can have peace of mind knowing that their rental is protected and accounted for at every step of the way. The equipment marketplace can also rest assured that their businesses' specific types of intrinsic risks are being addressed with a tailor made program instead of a more traditional "set it and forget it" option. Overall, complete journey visibility is a valuable tool for any equipment rental marketplace looking to improve its embedded protection program and provide the best possible experience for its customers.


- Customers can rest easy knowing their equipment is tracked throughout the entire journey, ensuring protection and accountability
- Custom protection programs can benefit marketplaces by addressing specific risks instead of relying on a generic option
- Having complete visibility of the journey is valuable in consistently improving the embedded protection program while providing customers with the best possible experience


[*source: Harvard Business Review](https://hbr.org/2014/08/the-value-of-customer-experience-quantified)


## Compliant Processes


As an equipment rental platform, navigating legal and compliance regulations for a protection program is paramount to ensuring a secure and trustworthy service. However, observing and adhering to state, federal, and international laws and regulations has another huge perk; it will help align functionalities with specific requirements and improve operational efficiency while maintaining compliance with legal and regulatory standards.


- A straightforward claims process builds customer trust and satisfaction
- Compliant and templatized claims processes provide insights for program improvement
- A robust, fair, and compliant embedded protection program maintains a positive reputation


[*source: Colligo](https://www.colligo.com/cost-of-non-compliance/#:~:text=Non%2Dcompliance%20leads%20to%20the,brand%20they%20view%20as%20unethical.&text=Overall%2C%20the%20total%20cost%20for,reputation%20damage%20and%20other%20fees.)


## One Source of Truth


Integrating a protection program with a focus on data consistency is crucial to creating a safe and reliable marketplace for equipment rental. By centralizing customer information, rental orders, accounts, and invoices, this program ensures data integrity, ultimately safeguarding the platform and its users.


- Enhanced collaboration with streamlined communication
- Ensures the integrity and reliability of analytical results
- Elimination of manual integrations with a unified solution


[*source: Deloitte](https://www2.deloitte.com/content/dam/insights/us/articles/3924_Predictably-inaccurate/DUP_Predictably-inaccurate-reprint.pdf)
